profiles.notes: Historical 2026 undergraduate guidance; its published deadline has passed. Certificate-system points below are not IB scores. Degree and diploma conditions differ; programme-specific rules still need review. The English-grade inconsistency is preserved rather than resolved by inference.

requirements.label: School-leaver qualification
requirements.details: Normally Certificate IV/NCQF Level 4, such as BGCSE/equivalent, with six subjects at E or above.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

requirements.label: Bachelor's grades and points
requirements.details: Normally five subjects at C or above across one or two sittings, plus at least 34 BGCSE/equivalent points.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

requirements.label: Degree English grades: clarification needed
requirements.details: English must qualify. Page 9 specifies C for non-science degrees and D for science; page 10 also permits bachelor's consideration with E. Confirm the applicable rule with admissions.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

requirements.label: Diploma/certificate grades and points
requirements.details: Normally three C grades, English E and 30 points. Five subjects may suffice if the six-subject points threshold is met.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

requirements.label: 2026 application fee
requirements.details: BWP 250 for local and international applicants; non-refundable.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

requirements.label: Experience evidence where applicable
requirements.details: Where experience is required, complete it before applying and upload a supervisor's statement confirming its nature and duration.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

requirements.label: School-leaver application documents
requirements.details: Prepare the fee receipt, certified school certificate/results and certified identity document: Omang for citizens, or passport.

source.title: University of Botswana: Application requirements

requirements.label: Online application and contact details
requirements.details: Apply online through UB's Study link, with a working email address and accurate mobile number for decisions.

source.title: University of Botswana: How to apply for admission

requirements.label: Eligibility is not an offer
requirements.details: Selection depends on academic merit and available places; satisfying programme minima does not guarantee admission.

source.title: University of Botswana: How to apply for admission

requirements.label: Changing programme choices
requirements.details: Request study-choice changes by emailing admissions@ub.ac.bw.

source.title: University of Botswana: How to apply for admission

requirements.label: August 2026 deadline (past)
requirements.details: The published closing date for local and international August 2026 applications was 6 August 2026, already past when reviewed.

source.title: University of Botswana: How to apply for admission

requirements.label: Tracking a submitted application
requirements.details: After acknowledgement, use the supplied login details; navigate through Main Menu, Student Admissions, Self Service and Student Centre.

source.title: University of Botswana: How to apply for admission

requirements.label: Payment method and reference
requirements.details: Pay online or at a bank; bank deposit references should include the applicant's full name and Omang/passport number.

source.title: University of Botswana: How to apply for admission

profiles.notes: Mature Age Entry is a separate route for Botswana nationals, not a waiver available to all applicants. Only programmes explicitly offering this route qualify. Do not copy normal school-leaver thresholds into this scope.

requirements.label: Mature Age Entry
requirements.details: Botswana nationals without normal entry qualifications must take the appropriate Mature Age Entry examination, where their programme offers this route.

source.title: University of Botswana: 2026 undergraduate admissions guide

profiles.notes: Undated undergraduate English guidance and current online-portal instructions, checked on 2026-10-09. Select the actual intake in the portal; this scope does not assert that any intake is open. The portal fee classification explicitly includes SADC nationals. Programme-specific academic thresholds are not yet covered here.

requirements.label: English proficiency evidence
requirements.details: Provide English proficiency evidence; a school-certificate credit or O-Level English pass is normally required and accepted.

source.title: University of Zambia: Undergraduates

requirements.label: Programme choices
requirements.details: Select the school and intake; the portal permits up to three programme choices.

source.title: University of Zambia: Online application guide

requirements.label: Online supporting documents
requirements.details: Upload clear copies of a recent passport photograph, NRC/passport and academic qualifications; staff-child evidence is conditional on that status.

source.title: University of Zambia: Online application guide

requirements.label: Entering qualification grades
requirements.details: Enter ECZ O-Level or Cambridge subjects and grades exactly as shown on the qualification document.

source.title: University of Zambia: Online application guide

requirements.label: Portal application fee
requirements.details: Non-refundable: ZMW 150 for Zambian/SADC nationals; USD 60 for international applicants. Use the portal's nationality classification.

source.title: University of Zambia: Online application guide

requirements.label: Saved application is not submission
requirements.details: Step 1 creates an Applicant ID, not a completed submission. Resume using that ID and the original NRC/passport number.

source.title: University of Zambia: Online application guide

requirements.label: Review before final submission
requirements.details: Complete all six steps and verify details before submitting; the guide warns that submitted applications cannot be edited.

source.title: University of Zambia: Online application guide

requirements.details: The advertisement's application deadline was 17 April 2026; it had passed when checked on 9 October 2026.

requirements.label: ZAQA-certified Grade 12 results
requirements.details: Submit Grade 12 results certified by the Zambia Qualifications Authority for the application to be considered.

requirements.label: Selection and document integrity
requirements.details: Minimum qualifications do not guarantee a place; programmes may close early. Offers are provisional, and false documents can lead to cancellation.
